name: Bead of Force
description: A black glass bead no bigger than a fingertip.
body:
## What it does

Throw it up to 60 feet as an action. It bursts in a 10-foot sphere: everyone inside makes a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or takes 5d4 force damage. Then a globe of force closes over the area for a minute. Those who failed are trapped within; the rest are pushed out. Nothing passes the globe's wall, though the trapped can push it along at half speed.

features.name: Sphere
features.text: A 10-foot globe of force traps those who failed the save for a minute.
